title: Blamed for Capitalism... and for Communism?
hero_object: Contradictory Historical Propaganda Dossiers (Wall Street Ledger vs. Soviet Red Star)
hook: Wait. The same community gets blamed for capitalism—and communism?
punchline: If every outcome confirms your theory, what could ever prove it wrong?
visual_paradigm: Propaganda Contradiction Matrix & Archival Deconstruction (Split Navy/Crimson #0F172A / #991B1B, Gold #FDE047)

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: Wait. The same community gets blamed for capitalism—and communism?

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: Open the history of political propaganda. In one pamphlet, Jewish people are depicted as greedy Wall Street bankers dominating global finance.
scenes.on_screen: ACCUSATION A: RUTHLESS WALL STREET CAPITALISTS

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: Open another pamphlet from the exact same era. Now they’re accused of leading the Bolshevik revolution to overthrow private property.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: Stop and look at the contradiction. You cannot simultaneously run international private banking and be dedicated to abolishing private banking.

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: The reality? Jewish people, like any human population, span every political ideology: business owners, union organizers, conservatives, and socialists.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: Conspiracy logic doesn’t care about consistency. It just changes the villain costume to match whatever you already fear.
scenes.on_screen: THE CONSPIRACY SHIFTS TO MATCH ANY FEAR

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: If every outcome confirms your theory, what could ever prove it wrong?
scenes.on_screen: WHAT COULD EVER PROVE IT WRONG?
scenes.source: Beyond the Myth · Facts, not scapegoats
